# Amethyst Design Notes

## Source

ColorLib Bootstrap Footer 19 — purple gradient footer with 4 columns.
Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bft/bootstrap-footer-19/

## Layout

- 4-column grid (col-md-6 col-lg-3 each)
- Desktop: 4 columns side by side
- Mobile: stacks vertically

## Columns

1. About: icon heading, address/phone/email list, newsletter form
2. Latest News: icon heading, 2 news cards (thumbnail + text + meta)
3. Information: icon heading, nav links
4. Instagram: icon heading, 2x3 photo grid

## Bottom Bar

- Copyright left
- Component Dock attribution right
- Top border: rgba(255,255,255,0.1)

## Colors

- Background: linear-gradient(45deg, #2a1a5e, #5126a7)
- Text: rgba(255,255,255,0.3)
- Links: #fe59d7
- Hover: rgba(255,255,255,0.9)
- Headings: white
- Icon circles: #fe59d7 border/color

## Font

Poppins (Google Fonts), weights 300-900
